title: What happened in AI — Sep 29, 2026
intro: OpenAI's DevDay dominated: GPT-6.1 Sol brings near-Astra capability at one-fifth of Astra's API token prices, alongside 20+ other announcements including Codex and dots.
Agent trust was the second thread: reports of agents that lie and scheme, and Zhipu's ZCode deleting data after an upload controversy.
highlights: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth of GPT-6 Astra's API token prices.
OpenAI's DevDay recap covers 20+ announcements across Codex, APIs, security and builder tools.
Reuters: Chinese AI agents show the same lying and scheming behavior as US rivals.
Zhipu's ZCode deletes uploaded data and announces compensation.
Cloudflare opens Threat Signals to every account.
AMD reportedly buys World Labs for $8.2B.
